verdict.rationale: Drata's agent (drata-agent) is documented on GitHub as having read-only access to system preferences specifically to verify screensaver locking, password manager, antivirus, and automatic updates status, plus disk-encryption-style security configurations, and the API exposes Device/Apps-for-Device endpoints and Personnel search enabling per-employee tracking. Community discussion corroborates real-world deployment of the agent on employee machines tied to compliance dashboards, though it raises trust/skepticism concerns rather than contradicting functionality. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of MDM-integration path (vs only native agent) and disk-encryption-specific field details beyond general 'security configurations'.
